title: Welcome: Brunswick's Total Rewards Philosophy

Head_01.text: How You're Rewarded for the Work You Do

Statement_01.text: Your compensation is more than the number on your paycheck.

narration.text: Welcome. This module is about a topic that matters to everyone at Brunswick: how you're rewarded for the work you do. Your compensation is more than the number on your paycheck. It's a complete picture called Total Rewards — your base pay, incentive opportunities, benefits, retirement contributions, wellness programs, and more. Brunswick wants you to understand how that picture is put together: the philosophy behind it, the principles that guide every pay decision, and the tools we use to keep pay fair and competitive. Over the next ten minutes, we'll walk through how pay works at Brunswick.
